List checks actually performed and their results, including anything not verified and why.

## 提交前检查 / Checklist

- [ ] 已完成与改动相关的验证，或在上文说明未验证的内容。 / Relevant checks are completed or their limitations are documented above.
- [ ] 如有用户可见文案变更，已同步中英文资源。 / English and Chinese resources are updated for user-visible text changes, if applicable.
- [ ] 如有功能或构建步骤变更，已同步相关文档。 / Relevant documentation is updated for feature or build procedure changes, if applicable.
